titre: toxic exam season reminders that work a little TOO well #studytok #studytips #exams #studymotivation
notes: essai. Routine du 30/10 (ROUTINE-avant-bleo, 4 livraisons). Angle jamais fait chez nous : le ton toxique appliqué à la saison des examens, dans le schéma prouvé toxic-study-motivation (r 3,17, bb2eeefa ; r 2,84, 5d957bad). Accroches écrites : « toxic exam season reminders that work a little TOO well » (retenue : la forme du gagnant, le twist de saison), « toxic thoughts to get you through exam season » (écartée : plus faible), « exam season motivation that is a little TOO honest » (écartée : perd le TOO well). Sept rappels neufs, rivalité avec soi-même seulement, aucun gros mot ; la santé reste positive (dormir, pas de nuit blanche). Place micabo : slide 4 (se tester) ; place UnSwipe : slide 6 (le scroll). slides.texte_overlay:
toxic exam season reminders
that work a little TOO well

the exam date is not moving.
your start date is the ONLY thing you control.

you're not "bad at maths".
you did 3 exercises. do 30, then we'll talk.

if you can't explain it without your notes,
you don't know it yet. test yourself. TONIGHT.

being tired in exam season is normal.
being tired AND unprepared is a choice.

nobody ever said "so glad i scrolled for 2 hours"
the week before an exam. NOBODY.

the exam doesn't care how long you studied.
it only checks what you REMEMBER.

sleep tonight, do well tomorrow.
an all-nighter is a trap, not a flex.
